what: the mandatory related host tests, judged from each unit own evidence and raw channel rather than from the summary a runner wrote, plus fourteen single-condition mutations of the collected set that the same judge must refuse

set.what: the NativeRuntime host unit, every case

requirement.note: the set is independent of the caller: no argument removes a unit, and the runtime unit is required rather than optional, which is the 140 defect this file exists to correct

mutations.name: drop-runtime-unit
mutations.why: the unit the gate exists for is left out
problems: required unit absent: runtime (the NativeRuntime host unit, every case)

mutations.name: drop-runtime-case-10
mutations.why: a case is quietly removed instead of repaired
problems: the runtime unit lists 10 cases, the requirement is 11
the runtime unit is missing case 10

mutations.name: row-exit-rewritten-to-zero
mutations.why: the row claims success the run did not report
problems: case 10: the row says exit 0, the evidence says 81

mutations.name: raw-identity-fabricated
mutations.why: a made-up hash is offered as the channel
problems: case 5: the row identity is not the raw channel on disk

mutations.name: raw-bytes-shrunk
mutations.why: an empty channel is counted as a silent pass
problems: case 5: the row byte count is not the one on disk

mutations.name: pass-marker-fabricated
mutations.why: the verdict is read from a summary instead of the channel
problems: case 5: the raw channel carries no pass marker

mutations.name: swap-runtime-elf
mutations.why: a case ran a different image from its siblings

mutations.name: wrong-selector
mutations.why: the case number in the record is not the one the unit was given

mutations.name: drop-boot-diagnostic
mutations.why: a required unit disappears and the summary still says all passed
problems: required unit absent: boot_diagnostic (the BootDiagnostic host unit)

mutations.name: raw-says-pass-exit-says-fail
mutations.why: the marker is left in place beside a non-zero exit status

mutations.name: safe-tss-raw-removed
mutations.why: the channel the verdict is read from is emptied
problems: safe_tss has no readable raw channel

mutations.name: safe-tss-inner-removed
mutations.why: the tool return code has no source left
problems: safe_tss has no readable inner report

mutations.name: not-an-accepted-stage
mutations.why: a stage the bridge did not accept is counted anyway
problems: boot_diagnostic was not an accepted guarded stage

mutations.name: boot-diagnostic-no-marker
mutations.why: a silent run is counted as a pass
problems: boot_diagnostic raw channel contains no PASS marker
